data.text:
Santhosh Boban vs The Administrator on 12 April, 2024 
Author: P Gopinath
Bench: P Gopinath
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr. Justice Gopinath P.
 Friday, the 12th day of April 2024 / 23rd Chaithra, 1946
 Wp(C) No. 9605 Of 2012(A)
Petitioners:
 1. Santhosh Boban, S/O. V. Narayanankutty Menon, Municipal Councilor,
 Unnayi Warrier Ward-Xxvi, Irinjalakuda.P.O 680 121,Thrissur Dt
 2. Raji Suresh Municipal Councilor, Sree Koodalmanickam Ward-
 Xxv, Irinjalakuda.P.O 680 121,Thrissur Dt
Respondents: 
 1. The Administrator, Sree Koodalmanickom Devaswom Managing Committee,
 Irinjalakuda.P.O 680 121, Thrissur Dt
 2. State Of Kerala Represented By Principal Secretary, Department Of
 Devaswom, Secretariat, Thiruvananthapuram - 695 001. 
 3. The District Collector, Civil Station, Thrissur 680 001.
 4. The Chief Wildlife Warden, Forest & Wild Life Department,
 Thiruvananthapuram - 695 001. 
 Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be pleased to direct the respondents to take immediate and effective steps to provide for the safety and healthy custody of the animal and prevent loss of damage to people and property, pending disposal of the WP. 
 This petition coming on for orders upon perusing the petition and the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and upon hearing the arguments of SRI.K.G.BALASUBRAMANIAN & SMT.AMBILY PREMKUMAR, Advocates for the petitioners, M/s N.N.SUGUNAPALAN and S.SUJIN, Advocates for R1, GOVERNMENT PLEADER for R2 to R3, and of Advocate SRUTHY N. BHAT as AMICUS CURIAE, the court passed the following:
 GOPINATH P., J.
 -------------------------------------------------
 W.P (C) No. 9605 OF 2012  -------------------------------------------------
 DATED THIS THE 12th DAY OF APRIL, 2024  ORDER Santhosh Boban vs The Administrator on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105020803/
1 The learned Amicus Curiae has placed on record an affidavit placing certain suggestions regarding feeding of the captive elephant belonging to Koodalmanickom Devaswom. She has also placed certain suggestions regarding physical infrastructure that has to be put in place. The Koodalmanickom Devaswom has taken a positive stand in the matter. They state that they are willing to implement the suggestions. The competent authority of the Devaswom will, take into consideration the suggestions in the report of the learned Amicus Curiae and inform this court by the next date of posting as to what steps have been taken to implement all or any of them. This court expects that the Deveswom will start implementing the suggestions without undue delay. 
2. Since it is pointed out that the annual festival of the Koodalmanickom temple is scheduled to commence on 21-04-2024, I also direct that the Devaswom shall ensure that all captive elephants brought to temple in connection with festival are properly cared for and sufficient food and fodder made available to the captive elephants. 
Post on 20-05-2024. 
Sd/-
GOPINATH P. JUDGE AMG 12-04-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Santhosh Boban vs The Administrator on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105020803/
2
